title: Publish Draft Version 10

requirements.text: Publish (promote) Draft Version 10 as the live/production version of the app, with no code changes, so the publicly shareable live link serves Version 10.
acceptanceCriteria: The live/production deployment points to Draft Version 10.
No frontend or backend source files are changed as part of this request.
After publishing, opening the public live link shows the Version 10 build (matching the Draft Version 10 preview).

constraints: Do not modify application code or assets; this request is deployment-only.
User-facing text in any deployment/publish confirmation (if shown) must be in English.
